current_example.problem:
Given the function 

$$
f(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{w}) = -7\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{x} + 3\|\mathbf{w}\|^2 - 2
$$

that maps two vectors to a scalar, find $\nabla_{\mathbf w} f .$
current_example.worked_solution:
Using the results 

$$
\nabla_{\mathbf w}(\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{x}, \qquad \nabla_{\mathbf w} (\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{w}) = 2\mathbf{w},
$$

 
we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{∇}_{w}f & ={∇}_{w}(-7{w}^{T}x+3‖w{‖}^{2}-2) \\  & =-7\cdot {∇}_{w}({w}^{T}x)+3\cdot {∇}_{w}(‖w{‖}^{2})-{∇}_{w}(2) \\  & =-7\cdot {∇}_{w}({w}^{T}x)+3\cdot {∇}_{w}({w}^{T}w)-{∇}_{w}(2) \\  & =-7\cdot x+3\cdot 2w-0 \\  & =-7x+6w.\end{aligned}
$$
